title: Kanye West & Kim Kardashian Mayhem In Hollywood
htmlContent:
In 2014 Kanye & Kim found love, and the two got married riding off into the sunset; the couple had planned to live happily ever after. But, instead, seven years after tying the knot, Kim filed for divorce in 2021, and the narrative switched. They went from being reviewed as the happy couple in the Hollywood spotlight, making family Tik Toks together, and living the dream to complete chaos.

Recently Kanye's & Kim's daughter Chicago celebrated her 4th birthday. Jason Lee from "Hollywood Unlocked" spoke on Clubhouse in "AAYAN FIX MY L!FE". She was stated that Ye was not invited to the party. The drama has spilled so out of control that he did not even know where the party was located initially. The rapper found out via Travis Scott. Ye & Kim share four small children amid a potentially super ugly divorce. North, Saint, Chicago, and Psalm. When it comes to co-parenting, the two have not been seeing eye to eye or on the same page, if at all, despite their issues.

Kayne Has expressed himself as a father who did not agree to Kim's decision to allow their daughter North to be on the relatively new social media app Tik Tok. This past Friday, Ye shared screenshots on IG of the 8-year-old from one of her videos, posted with his wife Kim Kardashian's approval! He wrote, "SINCE THIS IS MY FIRST DIVORCE, I NEED TO KNOW WHAT I SHOULD DO ABOUT MY DAUGHTER BEING PUT ON TIK TOK AGAINST MY WILL?" Jason Lee explained how he advised the rapper to stop fueling with Kim and challenge the platform policy instead. Many believe Ye is furious over the ongoing divorce and Kim's new boyfriend Pete Davidson. However, he said he isn't taking any chances and has reportedly hired extra security after Kayne threatened to "kick his A**" in a new song.

Does it ever end? How far is too much social media? Why are children suffering the most when parents decide to separate or divorce..?
